guide.summary: Council isolated the issue to stalled update services after a cumulative patch.
guide.chiefVerdict: Restart the update stack first, then rescan before changing anything else.

councilDiscussion.content: The measured evidence points to the service layer rather than disk pressure.
councilDiscussion.headline: Service-side fault

steps.title: Open Services
steps.instructions: Open Services, restart Windows Update and Background Intelligent Transfer Service, then confirm both return to Running state.

steps.title: Rescan after restart
steps.instructions: Run the quick health check again immediately after the restart so the next council pass can compare against the same baseline.
